title: A 247 AD Temple, Boxed In by Shanghai's Malls — Stop or Shop? | China Travel Expert
description:
Right on West Nanjing Road, Shanghai's busiest shopping strip, sits Jing'an Temple — a Buddhist temple first founded in 247 AD and moved to this exact spot back in 1216. Gold-tipped roofs, carved-wood halls and crowds of visitors, with luxury malls and glass towers pressing in on every side.

Walk the dim colonnade and the city noise drops away in seconds. Step back out and you're in the middle of the shopping rush again.

So which are you today — the quiet corridor, or West Nanjing Road?

★ Expert Tip: the temple has its own metro stop (Jing'an Temple, Lines 2 & 7), so you can duck in for 20 minutes between shopping and barely lose any time.

静安寺就在南京西路商圈正中：始建于 247 年，1216 年迁到现址，金顶木构紧挨着奢侈品商场。进去是清静，出来是人潮——你选哪个？
